notes: 10L/28R and 10R/28L confirmed as two separate physical parallel runways (opposite-threshold distances 1.78NM and 1.62NM respectively, bearing 095.7/275.7T both, matching the RNP Z approach inbound courses 096(095.7T)/276(275.7T)) from the real RNP Z RWY10L/10R/28L/28R waypoint lists in Quyet dinh 1287/QD-CHK ngay 12/6/2026. Dependent parallel runway operation per Du thao CV 5297/QLB-KL (see project memory project_vvpq_parallel_runway_procedure.md): 10L/28R used mainly for arrivals, 10R/28L used mainly for departures. This runway-role assignment (mainly-arrival vs mainly-departure per direction) differs from VVDN/VVCR's 'ARR on one runway / DEP on the parallel runway, both directions symmetric' style modes -- VVPQ's roles are fixed by physical runway (10L/28R = arrivals, 10R/28L = departures) rather than by heading alone, since it does not have DEP-role runways for 10R-direction landings or ARR-role for 10L-direction departures per the source document.
